note: archi.ru 2026-06-15 published «до редакции дошли сведения» about demolition with replacement by new brick, from unnamed sources, and stated it could not be confirmed at the time. Live counter of the archi.ru open letter to the mayor read 2026-10-22: 19 700 signatures. Meduza 2026-09-08: «более 19 тысяч». At launch (activatica 2026-06-26): ~2 820. No public source found stating >20 000. A second petition on change.org exists (linked by фонд «Внимание» 2026-06-23), but its counter is rendered client-side and could not be read — not verified. source_date here is the reading date of the live counter.

claim: Heritage-protection status of the site; which buildings are protected
note: Until mid-2025 the ensemble was a выявленный объект культурного наследия (temporary protection). Moscow law No.24 of 13.11.2024 removed protection from all выявленные objects not entered in the ЕГРОКН by 1 July 2025; Электрозавод was excluded together with roughly 1 500 other objects (Meduza 2026-08-07; archi.ru 2026-06-15; фонд «Внимание» 2026-06-23). No building of the ensemble was found to retain protected status in public sources. Flag: Etalon's press service told АГН «Москва» 2025-09-15 the site is «включен в реестр объектов культурного наследия» — contradicts the above. Building-level matrix belongs to T08.

The primary Etalon release (t.me/archi_ru/26936) was not opened — wording there unverified.

Etalon press service 2025-09-15: «Выход на стройплощадку и начало строительных работ запланированы на конец 2026 – начало 2027 года». Meduza 2026-08-07 repeats «в конце 2026 — начале 2027 года»; sales from 2028. No public source found naming March 2027. The brief's March 2027 falls inside the stated window but is not itself documented.
